text: Agile methodology is a popular approach to managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of doing all the work at once, teams work in short cycles called sprints, which usually last two to four weeks. At the start of each sprint, the team selects tasks from a prioritized list called the backlog. These tasks are often written as user stories, brief descriptions of a feature from the perspective of the end user. Every day, the team holds a quick standup meeting, where each member shares what they did yesterday, what they will do today, and any obstacles they face. This iterative process allows for constant feedback and adjustments, ensuring the final product truly meets the needs of the users.
